trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read: definition block, defined term bolded, an announced three-condition list (First/Second/Third) and a fenced tikzcd decomposition square. trap-triples PASSES -- the three items are the defining axioms of the Reeb derivation, a substantive enumeration. No other category fires. OUT-OF-SCOPE observations reported to the caller: (i) DUPLICATE DEFINED TERM -- this block bolds 'categorical Reeb derivation' for \xi : A -> A with axioms (\pi_V \circ d = \iota_\xi d\varTheta_A, \varTheta_A(\xi)=\mathrm{id}, \Omega^k_H = \ker\iota_\xi), while def:categorical-reeb-derivation bolds the SAME term for a different morphism \xi_q : A -> A with different axioms (\xi_q\circ\varTheta=\varTheta, Leibniz); two definition blocks, one term, two objects. (ii) the axiom \pi_V \circ d = \iota_\xi d\varTheta_A conflicts with ex:categorical-reeb-brings, which computes \iota_\xi d\varTheta_A = 0 on the worked SU_q(2) model -- see that block's entry. (iii) 'normalized' here vs 'normalisation' in prf:categorical-reeb-unique, within one block group.
